posts.en:
dsh-tool-vision is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Local-first vision for the text-only DeepSeek Harness: a local VLM (LM Studio / Ollama / vLLM) produces structured JSON evidence (OCR / layout / semantics) at zero API cost, with image data never leaving the machine.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b1a68fb4f270afab006c.html
